description: The file defines an Android activity ContentInfoActivity that displays information about a media content item, fetches details from an API, and initiates media playback using ExoPlayer.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays content information (title, description, poster), fetches data from API endpoints, and handles media playback via ExoPlayer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads UI components, sets click listeners, loads poster image, and initiates fetching of content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content info from a constructed API URL and updates UI with title and description.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles the 'Watch now' button click, calls the playback API, retrieves media URL, and starts playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Initializes or reuses ExoPlayer, sets the media item with the provided URL, and begins playback.
